item.text: I’m verifying the democracy-resilience picture against a small set of current sources, then I’ll compress it into claim-level evidence with the main positive and negative signals.

item.text:
**Overall:** slightly stronger than inherited, but not cleanly. Lula’s 2024 record looks better than the Bolsonaro legacy on elections, media openness, and institutional normalcy, yet the year still ended with real pressure on the information environment and unresolved police-abuse problems.

- [Speech by President Lula at the opening of the 79th UN General Assembly in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/speech-by-president-lula-at-the-opening-of-the-79th-un-general-assembly-in-new-york) - Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs - 2024-09-24 - Lula explicitly framed democracy around free and fair elections, transparent political processes, separation of powers, organizing rights, and human rights. This is direct pro-resilience evidence. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.5.

- [Brazil: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/brazil/freedom-world/2024) - Freedom House - 2024 - Freedom House rated Brazil “Free,” described a vibrant media environment, and said Lula did not continue Bolsonaro-era monitoring of public servants for criticism. That is strong background evidence that the democratic baseline was healthier in 2024 than under Bolsonaro. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.6, 4B.9, 4B.5.

- [Digital News Report 2024: Brazil](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/brazil) - Reuters Institute - 2024-06-17 - The report says the fake-news bill was eventually abandoned and mainstream outlets remained trusted despite polarization. That supports a more permissive information environment, even though pressure and polarization remained. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.6, 4B.9, 4B.5.

- [Brazil | World Report 2024](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/brazil) - Human Rights Watch - 2024-01-11 - HRW reported that Lula’s government unblocked more than 3,000 social-media users previously blocked from institutional accounts under Bolsonaro. This is a concrete reversal of prior restrictions and a real pro-freedom move. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.6, 4B.9.

- [Lula diz que não tem candidatos para presidentes da Câmara e do Senado](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/09/05/lula-diz-que-nao-tem-candidato-nem-para-a-camara-nem-para-o-senado.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-09-05 - Lula said the choice of congressional leaders belongs to the parties and lawmakers, not to him personally. That supports coalition autonomy and a non-personalist governing style. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.8, 4B.4.

- [Partidos de centro e da direita consolidam vitória no 2º turno das eleições municipais](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/10/27/partidos-de-centro-e-da-direita-consolidam-vitoria-no-2-turno-das-eleicoes-municipais.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-10-27 - Center-right and right parties won most major municipal races, including Lula’s setback in São Paulo, and the coverage shows no sign of retaliation or refusal to accept the results. This is practical evidence that turnover remained real and tolerated. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.3, 4B.8.

- [Lula diz que aqueles que planejaram e executaram o 8 de janeiro devem ser punidos](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-01-08 - Lula demanded punishment for the January 8 coup plotters rather than retaliation, collective punishment, or tolerance. That is strong evidence that he backed constitutional order against anti-democratic violence. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.1, 4B.8, 4B.5.

- [mjsp lança diagnóstico sobre o uso de câmeras corporais pelos agentes de segurança pública](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/mjsp-lanca-diagnostico-sobre-o-uso-de-cameras-corporais-pelos-agentes-de-seguranca-publica) - Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública - 2024-07-31 - The ministry linked body cameras to lower police lethality and more reporting, which supports stronger accountability and less abusive state power. Along with the December force-decree, this points to some institutional strengthening. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.4, 4B.5, 4B.9.

- [Decreto que atualiza regras sobre o uso diferenciado da força pelas polícias é publicado](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/decreto-que-atualiza-regras-sobre-o-uso-diferenciado-da-forca-pelas-policias-e-publicado) - Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública - 2024-12-24 - Lula signed a decree updating police-use-of-force rules around legality, precaution, necessity, due process, and non-discrimination. That is a pro-resilience reform, but it also shows the state still needed active correction. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.4, 4B.5, 4B.9.

- [YouTube retira do ar desinformação sobre estado de saúde do presidente da República](https://www.gov.br/agu/pt-br/comunicacao/noticias/youtube-retira-do-ar-desinformacao-sobre-estado-de-saude-do-presidente-da-republica/) - Advocacia-Geral da União - 2024-12-16 - The government formally pressured YouTube to remove videos spreading false claims about Lula’s health. This is the clearest counterevidence on information freedom: targeted state pressure existed, even if framed as anti-disinformation. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.6, 4B.9, 4B.5.

- [X has been blocked in Brazil. Does it matter for journalism?](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/news/x-has-been-blocked-brazil-does-it-matter-journalism) - Reuters Institute - 2024-09-16 - Brazil’s Supreme Court blocked X after the platform refused legal orders, showing a tighter online environment. This is a real caveat for democratic resilience, though it is not clear Lula himself directed it. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.6, 4B.9, 4B.5.

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) - Human Rights Watch - 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events - HRW reported continued police killings in 2024 and prison conditions marked by overcrowding and ill-treatment/torture. That means democratic resilience improved politically, but was still badly incomplete in everyday rights practice. Question IDs: 4B.10, 4B.7, 4B.4, 4B.9.
